tagline: Local AI subtitle generation for media servers
description:
Subgen transcribes personal audio and video files into subtitles using faster-whisper and stable-ts. It can be used as a Bazarr Whisper provider, receive webhooks from Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, or Tautulli, expose OpenAI-compatible audio transcription endpoints, and run manual jobs through its API documentation.

This ZimaOS package uses the CPU-only image for broad compatibility. Whisper models are cached under AppData, and optional `/tv` and `/movies` mounts let Subgen access the same media paths used by your media server when webhooks or batch jobs need direct file access.

**Notes:**
- Open `/docs` for the FastAPI Swagger interface.
- Configure Bazarr to use `http://<zimaos-ip>:19000` as the Whisper endpoint.
- For Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, or Tautulli webhooks, make sure Subgen sees media files at the same container paths as your media server, or adjust path mapping variables.

tips.before_install:
## Resource and Setup Notes

- This package runs on CPU. Transcription can be slow on low-power devices; reduce `WHISPER_MODEL` to `small`, `base`, or `tiny` if needed.
- First transcription downloads the selected Whisper model into `/subgen/models` and may take time.
- Subgen is an API/webhook service, not a full account-based web UI. Avoid exposing it directly to the public internet.
- The included thumbnail and screenshot are placeholder copies of the upstream icon because the upstream project does not ship UI screenshots.
